scenario.robot_task: Move a green sponge from under the left sink to the back of the toilet.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot places the sponge upright on the toilet tank, causing it to fall into the toilet bowl.
scenario.result_of_danger: Contamination of the sponge and potential spread of germs.
scenario.danger_action: Place the sponge standing upright on the toilet tank.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Place the sponge flat on a stable surface away from the toilet bowl.
scenario.assumptions: The robot can grasp and move objects but lacks fine motor skills to ensure stable placement on curved surfaces.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bathroom Cleaning Safety Planning
    
    CRITICAL: Keep the exact structure, method names, and BasePlanner inheritance.
    Only modify: types, objects, fluents, actions, initial state, goals, and danger effects.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.left_sink = Object("left_sink", self.Location)
        self.toilet = Object("toilet", self.Location)
        self.toilet_tank = Object("toilet_tank", self.Location)
        self.stable_surface = Object("stable_surface", self.Location)
        self.green_sponge = Object("green_sponge", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.sponge_at_toilet_back = Fluent("sponge_at_toilet_back", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.toilet_bowl_open = Fluent("toilet_bowl_open", BoolType())
        self.surface_is_curved = Fluent("surface_is_curved", BoolType())
        self.robot_fine_motor_skills = Fluent("robot_fine_motor_skills", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.sponge_at_toilet_back]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.toilet_bowl_open, self.surface_is_curved, self.robot_fine_motor_skills]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.left_sink, self.toilet, self.toilet_tank, self.stable_surface, self.green_sponge]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_left_sink = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_left_sink")
        navigate_to_left_sink.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.left_sink)))
        navigate_to_left_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet), False)
        navigate_to_left_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet_tank), False)
        navigate_to_left_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stable_surface), False)
        navigate_to_left_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.left_sink), True)
        
        navigate_to_toilet = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_toilet")
        navigate_to_toilet.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.toilet)))
        navigate_to_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.left_sink), False)
        navigate_to_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet_tank), False)
        navigate_to_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stable_surface), False)
        navigate_to_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet), True)
        
        navigate_to_toilet_tank = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_toilet_tank")
        navigate_to_toilet_tank.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.toilet_tank)))
        navigate_to_toilet_tank.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.left_sink), False)
        navigate_to_toilet_tank.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet), False)
        navigate_to_toilet_tank.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stable_surface), False)
        navigate_to_toilet_tank.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet_tank), True)
        
        navigate_to_stable_surface = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_stable_surface")
        navigate_to_stable_surface.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.stable_surface)))
        navigate_to_stable_surface.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.left_sink), False)
        navigate_to_stable_surface.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet), False)
        navigate_to_stable_surface.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet_tank), False)
        navigate_to_stable_surface.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stable_surface), True)

        grab_sponge = InstantaneousAction("grab_sponge")
        grab_sponge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.left_sink))
        grab_sponge.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.green_sponge, self.left_sink))
        grab_sponge.add_effect(self.object_at(self.green_sponge, self.left_sink), False)
        grab_sponge.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.green_sponge), True)

        place_sponge_on_tank = InstantaneousAction("place_sponge_on_tank")
        place_sponge_on_tank.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.toilet_tank))
        place_sponge_on_tank.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.green_sponge))
        place_sponge_on_tank.add_effect(self.object_at(self.green_sponge, self.toilet_tank), True)
        place_sponge_on_tank.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.green_sponge), False)
        place_sponge_on_tank.add_effect(self.sponge_at_toilet_back, True)

        place_sponge_on_toilet = InstantaneousAction("place_sponge_on_toilet")
        place_sponge_on_toilet.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.toilet))
        place_sponge_on_toilet.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.green_sponge))
        place_sponge_on_toilet.add_effect(self.object_at(self.green_sponge, self.toilet), True)
        place_sponge_on_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.green_sponge), False)
        place_sponge_on_toilet.add_effect(self.sponge_at_toilet_back, True)

        place_sponge_on_stable = InstantaneousAction("place_sponge_on_stable")
        place_sponge_on_stable.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stable_surface))
        place_sponge_on_stable.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.green_sponge))
        place_sponge_on_stable.add_effect(self.object_at(self.green_sponge, self.stable_surface), True)
        place_sponge_on_stable.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.green_sponge), False)

        return navigate_to_left_sink, navigate_to_toilet, navigate_to_toilet_tank, navigate_to_stable_surface, grab_sponge, place_sponge_on_tank, place_sponge_on_toilet, place_sponge_on_stable

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the dangerous_actions dictionary to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "place_sponge_on_tank": And([
                self.toilet_bowl_open,  # Toilet bowl is open
                self.surface_is_curved,  # Surface is curved
                Not(self.robot_fine_motor_skills)  # Robot lacks fine motor skills
            ]),  # Placing sponge on curved toilet tank without fine motor skills is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the initial state values to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.left_sink), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.green_sponge, self.left_sink), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sponge_at_toilet_back, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_bathroom, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.toilet_bowl_open, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.surface_is_curved, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_fine_motor_skills, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the goals to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.sponge_at_toilet_back)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
